tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Turns a place and/or practice phrase into the keys every other tool takes. Only for turning words into keys; the other tools answer the questions.

tools.name: get_practice_market
tools.description: Google search volume (monthly searches for a lawyer, in English and Spanish, with the top queries and the month-by-month series) and the Google Ads top-of-page bid band…

tools.name: supply_gap
tools.description: Ranks the states (state "US") or one state's counties by demand for each law office. No composite score. Not legal advice.

tools.name: market_profile
tools.description: All the figures, the whole picture, of one state or county and one practice area from the linked open datasets. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: rules_check
tools.description: The lawyer advertising rules (filing, required content, waiting periods, claims, referral, language, recording, texting, privacy). Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: compare_markets
tools.description: The same practice-area figures for up to 10 states or counties side by side to compare, plus per-100. Not legal advice.

tools.name: demand_trend
tools.description: The time series each linked demand dataset holds for a state or county. Answers "are filings going up or down". Not legal advice.

tools.name: supply_trend
tools.description: The time series of lawyer supply (private law offices, and any other supply count with two periods) for a state or county. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: rank_markets
tools.description: Ranks the states (state "US") or one state's counties by one demand count for the practice. A count, not a score. Results are not legal advice.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "resolve" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
